title: Lower body + calf/elbow PT · 23 October
label: 40 MIN · LOWER BODY AND REHAB
coachNote: Elbow more painful after swimming yesterday. Avoid loaded upper-body exercise today. Calf PT: standing calf raises 3x10 with +10 kg, seated Smith calf raises 3x10 with 40 kg ADDED PLATES (not including bar), standing toe raises 3x10. Lower-body superset B: leg extension + leg curl x3, rest 60 sec after pair. C: hip thrust + reverse crunch x2 if elbow-safe setup. D: gentle unloaded pain-free elbow flexion and extension for 1–2 minutes, no loaded triceps today unless specifically prescribed by PT. Stop exercises that worsen symptoms.

exercises.name: PT 1 — Standing calf raise
exercises.note: Record +10 kg external load and symptoms.

exercises.name: PT 2 — Smith seated calf raise
exercises.note: 40 kg added plates, excluding Smith bar/carriage. Use physiotherapist-approved technique.

exercises.name: PT 3 — Standing toe raise
exercises.note: Follow PT technique; record resistance if used.

exercises.name: B2 — Leg curl
exercises.note: Machine settings B-5, K-1, A-4. Rest 60 seconds after pair.

exercises.name: C1 — Hip thrust
exercises.note: Skip if loading/setup stresses the elbow.

exercises.name: D — Gentle unloaded elbow mobility
exercises.note: 1–2 minutes comfortable bending/straightening; reps field is a placeholder. No pain-provoking movement.
